sentences.text: If you melt rock deep underground and let it rise, you have a volcano.
But gas bubbles in the magma expand and build up pressure.
Then it blasts out the top and throws ash into the sky.
So the lava pours down and cools into a cone of rock.
But the next eruption buries that cone under another layer.
Layers of lava and ash stack up, one eruption at a time.
Mount Fuji is a stratovolcano 3,776 meters tall.
Add snow on the peak and rocks around the base.
Congratulations, you have built a volcano.
